notes.title: Fixes Fixes Fixes
notes.notes:
Achievements made more reasonable
Dadi and Rangeela find 50 items

notes.title: Steam Deck Verfied and 50% off
notes.notes: [h2]Dotson on Deck[/h2][p]Detective Dotson plays has received Steam Deck Verified status from Steam![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/6111e329ec441dfb9fd6813857ce96ff42a41679.png"][/img][/p][p]The game looks and plays really well on the deck with larger text adjusted for the device.[/p][p]Controller support is improved and the controller now works in the phone booth.[/p][p]We've also added Korean and Russian language support.[/p][p]Additionally there are performance fixes in the game.[/p][p][/p][h2]An exciting summer[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/72da169315152a0846d9e93eb91cad15ec727668.png"][/img][/p][p]We've got a summer filled with events and a 50% sale to celebrate[/p][p]We are part of Debut Festival from August 7[/p][p]We will be celebrating the Indian Independence Day on August 15[/p][h2][/h2][h2]Amma is coming[/h2][p]Don't get too comfortable in summer, because Amma is coming![/p][p]Our chapter 2 free update is in the works and we are busy adding twists and turns you won't see coming.[/p][p]What's more Detective Dotson will be at Gamescom and Tokyo Games Show[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/98470907cbd4760398ae13e24aad5afa0282c60e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/9e88effb51727d411331c2ccb04dfc22d1bb4a26.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Detective Dotson is a mystery adventure that's a love letter to India worth exploring out now
notes.notes:
With a setting that not many games explore, Detective Dotson is a fresh adventure from Masala Games that's out now with Linux support. India is brought to life with some lovely pixel artwork in this new release, it's really quite eye-catching.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/detective-dotson-is-a-mystery-adventure-thats-a-love-letter-to-india-worth-exploring-out-now/

notes.title: Achievements are here!
notes.notes:
You get achievements for
Solving cases
Beating the minigames
Being a good citizen and throwing trash in the bin
Reading minds

and of course
DANCING
yes, there is a bollywood dancing achievement

I will go out on a limb and say that's a first ever in a video game

notes.title: Indian mystery adventure game Detective Dotson arrives April 3 with a demo available
notes.notes:
Detective Dotson is a mystery adventure game set in a stylised rendition of modern-day India that puts players in the role of Dotson, a reluctant detective.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/01/indian-mystery-adventure-game-detective-dotson-arrives-april-3-with-a-demo-available/

notes.title: New Demo + Wholesome Games celebration!
notes.notes:
Announcing a brand new demo for Detective Dotson!
Available from August 15 - August 22 only. 📝

We are celebrating 15,000 wishlists 💪
We are celebrating the 15th of August - our independence day! 🙏
AND we are a part of the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration!! 🥳

So why is Detective Dotson going wholesome?
Well, we've always wanted to tell stories from the modern day semi-urban India we grew up in . From idyllic temple pathways to snug apartment complexes, Detective Dotson’s adventure couldn’t be at a place more wholesome — home. 🏡

Like Dadi says - it's an auspicious day! 💖

notes.title: Detective Dotson is part of the PixElated Festival
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44273861/8cb7d44a9a6fd9336fb7c600d94a939a7b89055a.png[/img]

We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that Detective Dotson is part of the PixElated Festival!

This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!

There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ [url=https://bit.ly/DDotSteam]demos[/url] ✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: [url= http://pixelatedfest.com/]PixElated Festival[/url]
